subtitle: Crispy Quorn nuggets with basmati rice and sweet, mildly spiced katsu sauce, suited to vegetarians and diners who prefer gentle spice.
quickAnswer: The Katsu Quorn Nugget Curry typically costs {price}, contains {calories} kcal and comes with eight crispy Quorn nuggets, basmati rice and katsu curry sauce. Prices vary by pub, with [Curry Club](/curry-club) pricing on Thursdays. Its sweet, mildly spiced sauce makes this a vegetarian option for diners who prefer gentle spice.

components.name: Quorn nuggets
components.note: Eight crispy, golden nuggets provide the savoury bite and crunch that contrasts with the smooth katsu curry sauce.

components.name: Basmati rice
components.note: A bed of basmati rice sits beneath the nuggets, providing the base for the generous serving of curry sauce.

components.name: Katsu curry sauce
components.note: Rich, sweet and mildly spiced sauce brings a smooth texture and an aromatic, savoury flavour to the plate.

taste:
This curry combines crisp Quorn nuggets with a smooth, sweet and mildly spiced katsu sauce. The eight golden nuggets supply the main textural contrast, retaining their crunch against the generous ladle of sauce. Savoury flavour balances the sweetness, so the appeal is as much about that combination as it is about the gentle spice. It suits someone seeking a comforting curry rather than a strongly spiced meal.

Served steaming hot, the nuggets sit on a bed of basmati rice with the sauce over them. Each mouthful brings together rice, smooth sauce and a crisp nugget bite. The overall character is rich and aromatic, with a straightforward meat-free centre to the dish.
value:
At a typical {price}, this curry is {pricePosition} in the [Curry Club](/curry-club) section we track. That gives you a useful starting point for judging value, although prices are set by each pub. Compare it with Katsu Chicken Curry if you are choosing between katsu options, or Sweet Potato, Chickpea & Spinach Curry if you want another meat-free choice.

Curry Club pricing applies on Thursdays. Participating pubs often include a drink in club meals, so check the local offer and eligible drinks before comparing the total cost with a separate food and drink order.
nutrition:
The listed serving contains {calories} kcal, equivalent to {calorieShare}, and is {caloriePosition} in the Curry Club section we track. Use that figure for the curry as described, with its nuggets, rice and katsu sauce, rather than as a total for everything you might order.

Additional sides, extra sauce or a drink can change the meal total. If you are comparing options, check the information for each addition separately. A vegetarian tag describes dietary suitability, not how the meal compares nutritionally with other curries.
dietaryGuidance:
This curry is tagged vegetarian, and our [allergen data](/allergen-information) lists milk and mustard. It is a meat-free choice, but the vegetarian label should not be read as a vegan label. Anyone avoiding milk or mustard should check the current allergen information with the pub before ordering.

Our listed allergens are not a substitute for the pub's current guidance. Ask about preparation and any proposed swaps, because changes to the nuggets, sauce or accompaniments can alter the allergens in the meal. Do not assume an adjustment makes it suitable for your requirements.

bestFor.title: Vegetarian curry diners
bestFor.text: Choose this if you want a meat-free curry built around nuggets rather than the cauliflower or sweet potato alternatives. Check the listed milk and mustard allergens if relevant.

bestFor.title: Gentle spice preferences
bestFor.text: The sweet, mildly spiced katsu sauce suits diners who want curry flavour without choosing a strongly spiced dish. Crisp nuggets add contrast to the smooth sauce and rice.

bestFor.title: Thursday pub meals
bestFor.text: Consider it for a Thursday visit when Curry Club pricing applies. Check your pub's price and whether an eligible drink is included before deciding on the full order.

pairings.reason: A bowl of chips is an optional extra if you want another side alongside the rice. Check the combined cost and nutrition before adding it.
Choose a side salad if you would rather add a salad than another portion of chips. Ask the pub about its ingredients and allergens.
The Mini Warm Chocolate Brownie is an option if you want a chocolate dessert after the curry. Check its dietary suitability separately from the vegetarian main.

tips: Check Thursday Curry Club pricing at your chosen pub before ordering, as the typical price is a guide rather than a fixed charge.
Ask which drinks qualify if you want a meal with a drink, then compare the total with ordering your preferred drink separately.
Review the current milk and mustard allergen information before ordering, and ask the pub to confirm how any requested swaps affect suitability.
Allow for the basmati rice already included when choosing extra sides. Add chips only if you want another side with the curry.
Order at the bar or through the Wetherspoon app at your table, checking the local menu for the dish and current price.

faqs.question: Is the Wetherspoons Katsu Quorn Nugget Curry spicy?

Its appeal is gentle spice alongside crisp nuggets and smooth sauce rather than strong heat. Spice tolerance varies, so ask the pub for guidance if you are particularly sensitive to spicy food.
